start: Settings, the newest app version installed

user_sees: Title 'What's new'
'What changed in the last 3 updates. Tap a button to try a change.'
The last 3 updates, newest first, each change with a button
must_not: Updates newer than the installed version
More or fewer than the last 3 updates

steps.action: Tap a change's button, for example 'What my gym can see'
user_sees: The page the change is about

user_sees: Title 'About'
Rows 'Credits', the RepDB credit link, and 'MettleUp' with the version
must_not: No version shown on a normal build

user_sees: The credits page
must_not: A blank page

steps.action: Tap the RepDB credit
user_sees: The exercise database page in the browser
must_not: A crash when no browser can open it

user_sees: 'Nothing new to show yet.'
must_not: An empty card
An error

steps.action: Update the app, open 'What's new'
user_sees: The new update on top; the oldest of the 4 dropped
must_not: The old list still shown

steps.action: Tap a try-it button, come back
user_sees: The same list
must_not: The list scrolled away or the button gone
